reasons.plausibility: Using a DNN potential trained on ab initio data to capture complex many-body interactions in high-entropy liquids is well-grounded in state-of-the-art computational materials approaches.
reasons.testability: Running parallel thermodynamic-integration simulations with both EAM and DNN references to compare free-energy outcomes provides a clear, decisive test protocol.
reasons.usefulness: Replacing EAM with a DNN potential to reduce path mismatch directly addresses a known limitation and would be highly valuable for researchers studying high-temperature HEAs.
